lore_anchors.definition: A master of puppetry in the Seamless Gate camp, whose status rivals Daofathers due to his direct allegiance to the Lord of All Demons.
An incredibly rare and expensive construct whose body is as durable as an Innate spirit treasure, making it nearly indestructible for anyone below the top tier of True God Daofathers.
The most powerful existence in the Seamless Gate camp, second only to the original 'King' who lost to Nuwa; his power has grown unfathomably over endless eons.
The nominal supreme commander of the Seamless Gate's forces, who manages the day-to-day war efforts across the Three Realms.
A powerful combat avatar formed by seven Empyrean Gods using Daoist Threelives' formation, whose attacks barely reach the Daofather threshold.
The name given to the combat avatar formed by the three Devouring Mountain Demon Gods in the Crimsonbright Realmverse war.
A Daofather-level major power serving as a strategist and commander for the Seamless Gate camp.
An extremely large-scale, high-value puppet project whose production is the primary task for the Seamless Gate's puppet masters.
The mobile fortress and command center of the Crimsonbright Realmverse forces in the realm war.
A high-tier magic treasure, of which the value of materials for a single Daofather puppet could purchase a thousand.
A Pure Yang treasure used by Ji Ning to house the relocated members of the Ji Clan in a contained world.
